'''Torunin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Tarasin]], who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Torunin was a member of the [[Wyrd]], a group of Tarasin [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Witch/Legends|witches]] that operated on Cularin. The Tarasin [[Savina]] was her bodyguard.

{{RPG}}
During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Torunin was present on Cularin in the central hut of the village where the [[Zhadorii irstat]] lived, when she was attacked by the [[heroes of Cularin]].
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Hunting the Wyrd]]'' the identity of the Wyrd sister and bodyguard that the player characters fight in the central hut varies, depending on player level. High-level players fight Torunin and Savina, but Mid-Level players fight [[Naelora]] and [[Kosaa]] instead, while Upper-Level players face [[Baeshana]] and [[Veshin]]. It is also possible for the players to avoid the hut, so the fight against Torunin doesn't even have to take place.
